atoms.a: The first bus arrived at 7:00 am. the second bus arrived at 7:20 am and the third one arrived at 7:40 am. How long are the intervals between buses, and when will the next bus arrive?
atoms.b: The buses are arriving at <mat><gap>20</gap></mat> minute intervals.
The next bus will arrive at <mat><gap>8</gap></mat>am.

atoms.a: Aki spends the same amount of money each day. On the first day she has £115, on the second day she has £98. What is the term-to-term rule of this sequence and how much money will she have on the third day?
atoms.b: To get to the next term, ((++subtract add)) ((++£17 £15 £12)).
On the third day, she will have <mat>£<gap>81</gap></mat>.

atoms.a: Each day, Wesley eats the same amount of strawberries. On the first day, there are 53 strawberries in his fridge. On the second day, there are only 41 strawberries left.
atoms.b: To get to the next term, ((++subtract add)) ((11 ++12 13)).
On the third day, there will be <mat><gap>29</gap></mat> strawberries left.
Wesley will run out of strawberries on day <mat><gap>6</gap></mat>.
